script_text: The Sun is about to turn against you, Leo, and you'll feel it before you see it. Early week, the Sun in Taurus squares your 4th house and Saturn in Aries tightens that grip, making Monday the moodiest day. Venus slides into your 5th house on Tuesday and suddenly your charm is weaponized — use it. Wednesday Venus sextiles Jupiter in Cancer trine your 5th, making it your power day for romance. Mid-week, Mars in Virgo sextiles your 10th house career sector, flipping the script on a stalled work project by Thursday. Late week, a Full Moon in Scorpio lights your 11th house, pulling old friends back or exposing who's truly loyal. Sunday's Sun conjunct your 7th house cusp opens a real conversation about commitment. Worst day is Monday thanks to that Sun-Saturn square draining your foundation. Your weekly move: say the bold thing before Thursday's window closes. Follow for daily updates.
